# Fixture attribution

The rule files under `mini-protocol/` are copied verbatim from the
**Document Parsing Protocol** (DPP), draft 0.1, by LlamaIndex —
repository: https://github.com/run-llama/document_parsing_protocol
(commit a9c49e24f6db653500cf7eab4b08019f23b74ea6).

The protocol and its examples are licensed **CC BY 4.0** (credit:
"Document Parsing Protocol, LlamaIndex"). They are included here, in
miniature, so the corpus-extraction tests can run without a network
checkout of the full protocol. Files:

- `mini-protocol/09 Tables/3 - Headers/Multi-Row Header Tiers.md`
- `mini-protocol/10 Forms/2 - Fields/Checkboxes.md`
- `mini-protocol/11 Charts/1 - The annotation/Labels.md`
